# garage_node_info (Data Source)

Read Garage node software information.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get info about the responding node
data "garage_node_info" "self" {}

# Get info about a specific node
data "garage_node_info" "specific" {
  node_id = "0123456789abcdef..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `node_id` (String) Node ID to query. Use 'self' for the responding node, or '*' for all.

### Read-Only

- `db_engine` (String) Database engine.
- `garage_features` (List of String) Garage features.
- `garage_version` (String) Garage version.
- `rust_version` (String) Rust version.
